answer: Registered battery storage technician with energy institute standing is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 379 aliases would need 379 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One violet of signal, one jetty of cost, one atlas of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
